$comment: Listing fields that apify push never sends, applied by scripts/store-metadata.mjs after every deploy. Title, description and categories live in actor.json. The evidence for the name, the price and every listing field: manager/docs/MARKET_CHECK/ats-jobs-dork-search.md (sections 10-11); measurements in the README and CHANGELOG.
seoTitle: Ashby Jobs Scraper - Search Every Ashby Job Board
seoDescription: Search every Ashby job board at once: titles, locations, remote or hybrid, salaries and posting dates. Newest jobs first, read live, no login or API key.
exampleRunInput$comment: Equal to the INPUT_SCHEMA prefill, so it is also the input of Apify's daily QA run (must succeed with rows within 5 minutes). Local run 2026-09-30: 3,814 boards read, 1,389 with a matching title, 362 software engineer jobs posted in the last 7 days, the 20 newest saved, 91 s.
isPublic$comment: Private until the platform tests pass (ci/README.md step 5).
defaultRunOptions$comment: 1024 MB: local runs peaked at 293-324 MB (the worst case, every job on Ashby, 146 s). Apify gives CPU in proportion to memory, so the platform runs decide whether 2048 MB is cheaper overall. 1800 s: the worst case read every board in under 3 minutes locally.

pricing.$comment: NOT APPLIED on the first deploy: the platform runs first measure what a run costs (the fixed cost is reading about 3,800 boards whatever the result), then the final events are set once. MAIN COMPETITOR for Ashby jobs: bovi/greenhouse-lever-ashby-job-scraper, 107 users in 30 days on 2026-09-30, $0.0015 per job (FREE) and $0.001485 (BRONZE), descriptions optional at the same price; next fantastic-jobs/ashby-jobs-api 81 users at $0.002. PLAN: job $0.0012 (a row without the description, 20% under bovi's full row), job-details $0.00135 (10% under bovi with descriptions). Where others are cheaper: jobo.world $0.00099, blackfalcondata $0.00095 + $0.005 start, webdata_labs $0.001, johnvc $0.0005 + $0.0002 per description, bujhmml $0.0004.

pricingInfos.reasonForChange: First pricing for 1.0: $1.20 per 1,000 jobs, $1.35 per 1,000 with full details, below the main Ashby jobs actor's $1.50. A run that fails on its input costs $0.

job.eventDescription: One saved job row: title, company, locations, work type, job type, department, pay summary, posting date, job and apply links. Also one checked job link that is closed or on no Ashby board.

job-details.eventDescription: One saved job row with full details on: everything in a Job row plus the full description (text and HTML), salary numbers, equity and the job's city, region and country.
